inputs.label: PSP games
inputs.help: Your own PSP game backups as .iso, .cso, .pbp or .chd files.

steps.text: Open PPSSPP VR from Library > Unknown Sources. Your games are in the game list. Set the virtual screen size in the settings.

notes: The GitHub releases of hrydgard/ppsspp have no Android or VR APK, so the APK comes from ppsspp.org. The URL names version 1.20.4 and must be updated by hand for new versions.
